biography.value:
Cobalt dragons live in high, frozen lands and keep to themselves. They are wary of visitors and strict about their territory, but loyal to those few they come to trust.

Unofficial 5e conversion of a dragon from an earlier edition of the game, for the Legacy Dragons module.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can use its [[/item .k5npEPc4lVRIDZN3]]{Frightful Presence}. It then makes three attacks: one with its [[/item .p2fRwPAZ3tVYaVot]]{bite} and two with its [[/item .DU4rqAZU5JS1nZG6]]{claws}.
If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

activation.condition: When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw.

description.value:
Each creature of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=0Z0wEIdg7Dn55ueh]] of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] for [[lookup @labels.duration activity=0Z0wEIdg7Dn55ueh]].

A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.
description.chat: Each creature of the [[lookup @name]]{monster}'s choice that is within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=0Z0wEIdg7Dn55ueh]] of the [[lookup @name]]{monster} and aware of it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns.

effects.name: Frightful Presence
effects.description:
You are &reference[frightened apply=false] for 1 minute.

You can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of your turns, ending the effect on yourself on a success. If your saving throw is successful or the effect ends for you, you are immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

description.chat: The [[lookup @name]]{monster} slams its long tail against its foe!

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} beats its wings. Each creature within [[lookup @labels.description.range activity=N0rhMZr4QHJMzTCJ]] of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or take [[/damage average]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can then fly up to half its flying speed.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses one of the following breath weapons.

Cold Breath. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a blast of blue-white cold in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=gJX1OsbvcVtywvYS]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save activity=gJX1OsbvcVtywvYS]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=gJX1OsbvcVtywvYS]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Binding Breath. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} unleashes its binding Breath in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=CNTmP7VG3qawSRCG]]. Each creature in that area must succeed on a [[/save activity=CNTmP7VG3qawSRCG]] saving throw or be encased in ice, &Reference[restrained] until the end of its next turn.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, &reference[difficult terrain] composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

On initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties), the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes a lair action to cause one of the following effects; it can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:

  • Ice spreads across the ground within 60 feet; the area is difficult terrain until initiative count 20 on the next round.
  • Icicles fall on a creature the dragon can see: DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) piercing damage.
  • Freezing fog fills a 20-foot sphere; the area is heavily obscured.
